# STES STAR

STES STAR coordinates China company registration and market entry for foreign founders and overseas companies.

- Brand: STES STAR / Stellaris Secretarial Services

- Service hours: Monday-Friday, 09:00-18:00 China time (UTC+8)
- Response standard: first WhatsApp acknowledgement within 30 minutes during service hours
- Languages: English, Korean, Arabic and Russian
- Main coordination base: Chengdu; projects may be coordinated in Shanghai, Beijing, Shenzhen, Guangzhou and other major Chinese cities after local feasibility review

## Service and pricing summary

- Company registration plus a one-year registered address: USD 2,500-3,500; estimated delivery cost RMB 5,000-8,000; indicative gross margin 60-70%.
- Work permit plus residence permit coordination: USD 1,200-1,800; estimated delivery cost RMB 4,500-6,000; indicative gross margin 40-50%.
- Registration and permit combination: USD 3,500-5,000; estimated delivery cost RMB 10,000-14,000; indicative gross margin 55-65%.
- Annual bookkeeping: USD 800-1,200; estimated delivery cost RMB 1,200-4,800; indicative gross margin 50-60%.
- Full first-year package: USD 4,500-6,000; estimated delivery cost RMB 13,000-20,000; indicative gross margin 50-60%.

Delivery cost is an internal fulfilment estimate, not a government fee. Prices and margins are planning ranges and may change with city, activity, investor documents, address, licences, bank requirements and project complexity.

## Timeline summary

- Name and route check: target 3-5 working days.
- Business licence: target 2-4 weeks.
- Chops, tax and related onboarding: about 1 week.
- Corporate bank account: target 2-4 weeks, subject to independent bank KYC and approval.
- Work and residence permits: target 4-6 weeks, subject to eligibility and authority approval.
- Typical total: 4-8 weeks, or 8-12 weeks when work and residence permits are included.

Targets start after a complete, usable document pack is accepted. No registration, banking, tax, licence, work-permit, residence-permit or visa result is guaranteed.

## Primary legal baselines

- PRC Foreign Investment Law and pre-establishment national treatment plus the negative-list system.
- 2024 Foreign Investment Negative List, effective 1 November 2024.
- Current PRC Company Law and capital-contribution implementation rules, including the five-year framework for new limited-liability companies.
- SAMR 2026 market-entity registration document standards.

Use the localized canonical pages for complete wording, exclusions, refund conditions and current source links.
